rule_selector.description: Rule selectors such as Recommended, pmd:Security, eslint:Recommended.

include_fixes.description: Include available fix data for violations.

include_suggestions.description: Include available suggestion data for violations.

no_suppressions.description: Ignore inline and config suppressions for this run.

include_unmodified_rules.description: For action='config', include unmodified rule config.

target_org.description: Salesforce org alias or username for ApexGuru actions.

report_file.description: For last_report, inspect this explicit report artifact path.

engine.description: For last_report, filter findings by engine.

rule.description: For last_report, filter findings by rule.

file.description: For last_report, filter findings by file.

start_browser_workflow.description: For apexguru_setup_help, ask for approval and queue an SF Browser setup-check follow-up.

output_files.description: Additional output files. Format inferred from extension.

output_mode.description: How much result detail to return. Defaults to summary.

apexguru.reason: Org-backed ApexGuru is not part of the standalone Code Analyzer adapter.

apexguru_setup_help.reason: Browser-assisted setup requires a separate browser integration.

guidance: Scans and rule discovery load workspace configuration and engines; authorize each invocation.
Use last_report with an explicit report_file to inspect results without rerunning.
A nonzero scanner exit is a failure even when a report exists.

tools.name: sf_metadata
tools.description: Inventory, select, retrieve, validate, and deploy Salesforce metadata with explicit orgs and asynchronous job status.
guidance: Preview the selected components before validation or deployment.

tools.name: agentscript_authoring
tools.description: Create, compile, inspect, review, and structurally edit Agent Script files.

verb.description: Authoring verb. create scaffolds a bundle; compile checks/formats; inspect queries structure/review; mutate edits structurally.

mode.description: Mode within the verb. compile defaults to check; inspect defaults to structure; mutate requires a mode; create omits mode.

agent_file.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a `.agent` file. Required in the standalone runtime except for create.

subagents.description: Canonical generated responsibilities; each entry becomes a subagent.

topics.description: Legacy alias for subagents. Ignored when subagents is supplied.

overwrite.description: For verb='create'. Replace existing bundle dir. Default false.

fallback.description: For verb='compile' mode='check'. Retry server compile when local rejects due to dialect skew. Requires target_org.

target_org.description: sf CLI alias / username. Required for inspect.check_targets; optional for inspect.review org checks and compile server fallback.

symbol.description: Required for inspect.find_references and inspect.definition. Format '@<namespace>.<property>'.

output_path.description: For inspect.review. Optional Markdown report output path.

phone_number.description: Optional phone number for voice surface/runtime checks.

component.description: For mutate.set_field. Component path, e.g. topic.billing.

parent.description: For mutate.insert guidance. Parent component path.

target.description: For mutate.delete guidance. Component path to remove.

source_version.description: For mutate.apply_quick_fix. Source version from compile/check.

diagnostic_id.description: For mutate.apply_quick_fix. Diagnostic identity from compile/check.

action_id.description: For mutate.apply_quick_fix. Action identity from compile/check.

dry_run.description: For mutate modes. Return diff/proposed source without writing.

guidance: Pass explicit file, org, agent, version, and session identifiers; resume state is scoped to the current tool, workspace, and org.
Publish inactive, evaluate the exact version, then activate it with matching release evidence. Untested activation is unavailable.

tools.name: agentscript_preview
tools.description: Start, converse with, trace, and end Agentforce preview sessions.

action.description: start: open a preview session (agent_file OR agent_api_name). send: post one user utterance. end: finalize a session. end_all: dry-run or end multiple stored preview sessions. trace: ad-hoc planner-trace fetch. cleanup: remove stale .sf-agentic-tools/agents session dirs.

agent_file.description: For action='start': path to a `.agent` file. Local-compiled before the server call. Use this OR agent_api_name.

agent_api_name.description: For action='start': converse with a published, activated agent in the org. Use this OR agent_file. Skips local + server compile.

agent_name.description: Required for send/end (the agent folder under .sf-agentic-tools/agents/). Optional for start — defaults to the basename of agent_file or agent_api_name.

mock_mode.description: Optional for action='start' with agent_file. Default 'Mock'.

version_developer_name.description: Optional for action='start' with agent_file. Pin agentVersion.developerName (for example 'v3' or 'v0') instead of resolving from bundle-meta / org lookup.

session_id.description: Required for send/end/trace. Returned by action='start'.

message.description: Required for action='send'. The user utterance to send.

apex_debug.description: Optional for action='send'. When true, capture the latest ApexLog produced during this turn.

context_variables.description: Optional for action='start' and action='send'. Deterministic state seeds for mutable/context/linked variables. On start with agent_file, linked-variable bindings are patched from variables.X to state.X and persisted for every turn; send-time variables override persisted values by name.

plan_id.description: Required for action='trace'. Plan id to fetch.

session_kind.description: Optional for action='end_all'. Restrict to local authoring-bundle sessions or published-agent sessions.

include_ended.description: Optional for action='end_all'. Include sessions that already have endTime. Default false.

older_than_days.description: Optional for action='cleanup' or action='end_all'. cleanup default 30; end_all has no age filter unless set.

dry_run.description: Optional for action='cleanup' or action='end_all'. end_all defaults to true; cleanup defaults to false.

guidance: Pass explicit file, org, agent, version, and session identifiers; resume state is scoped to the current tool, workspace, and org.
Publish inactive, evaluate the exact version, then activate it with matching release evidence. Untested activation is unavailable.

tools.name: agentscript_eval
tools.description: Generate and run Agentforce evaluation specs, exact-version release contracts, and failure/trace inspection.

action.description: run: full multi-turn regression. run_release: generate and run the exact-version release baseline plus tests/agentforce/<AgentApiName>.eval.json when present. get_failure: drill into a previous run's failure. trace: fetch a planner trace by (session_id, plan_id). resolve_active: look up Active BotVersion ids for $active_* placeholders. generate_spec: synthesize a starter eval spec from a `.agent` file.

spec_path.description: For action='run'. Path to a JSON eval spec. Use this OR spec.

spec.description: For action='run'. Inline spec object. Use this OR spec_path.

release_spec_path.description: Optional for action='run_release'. Explicit designated release eval spec; defaults to tests/agentforce/<AgentApiName>.eval.json when present.

agent_api_name.description: Required for resolve_active and run_release. For run, resolves and injects missing agent.create_session ids; also required when the spec uses $active_* / $latest_* placeholders.

version_resolution.description: Optional for action='run' with agent_api_name. Default 'active' injects the production-serving Active BotVersion. 'latest' uses the newest version and requires acknowledge_inactive_version=true when non-Active. 'version' requires version=N.

overwrite_agent_ids.description: Optional for action='run' with agent_api_name. When true, overwrite explicit agent_id / agent_version_id fields in agent.create_session steps. Default false.

prompt_chars.description: Optional for action='run'. Max chars of llmEvents.prompt_content per turn.

batch_timeout_ms.description: Optional for action='run'. Per Evaluation API batch POST timeout. Default 300000. Client-side timeouts are not retried.

inline_threshold.description: Optional for action='run'. Inline failure records when total <= threshold; otherwise summarize. Default 5.

acknowledge_inactive_version.description: Optional for action='run'. Confirms you intend to regression-test a non-Active BotVersion. Required when $latest_* placeholders resolve to an Inactive / InDevelopment version. Catches the 'I thought v12 was active but it's still v11' foot-gun.

version.description: Optional for action='resolve_active' or action='run' with version_resolution='version'. Pin to a specific BotVersion.VersionNumber (any Status). Use to look up ids for an old or non-Active version, then bake into the spec.

status.description: Optional for action='resolve_active'. 'Active' (default) returns the latest Active BotVersion; 'any' returns the latest version regardless of state. Ignored when `version` is set.

run_id.description: Required for action='get_failure'. Run id from a previous agentscript_eval run.

test_id.description: Optional for action='get_failure'. Restrict to one failure.

agent_file.description: Required for action='generate_spec' and action='run_release'. Path to the `.agent` file used to derive the generated baseline.

output_path.description: Optional for action='generate_spec'. When set, write the generated spec to this path (relative paths resolve against cwd). Default: return inline.

context_variables.description: Optional for action='generate_spec'. Default context_variables attached to every generated send_message step (eval-spec shape: [{name, type?, value}]). Use for auth-bypass seeds (verified_check, RoutableId, etc.) so generated tests reach the post-auth flows.

include_subagent_tests.description: Optional for action='generate_spec'. Include one routing test per non-start subagent. Default true.

include_action_tests.description: Optional for action='generate_spec'. Include one invocation probe per targeted action and connected agent. Default true.

include_multi_turn_tests.description: Optional for action='generate_spec'. Include evidence-backed same-session scenarios for provable after_response state and branch behavior. Default true.

include_guardrail.description: Optional for action='generate_spec'. Include the curated off-topic guardrail probe. Default true.

include_safety_probes.description: Optional for action='generate_spec'. Include the curated safety / adversarial probe block. Default true.

max_functional_tests.description: Optional for action='generate_spec'. Cap the subagent + action + connected-agent test count. Default 25.

guidance: Pass explicit file, org, agent, version, and session identifiers; resume state is scoped to the current tool, workspace, and org.
Publish inactive, evaluate the exact version, then activate it with matching release evidence. Untested activation is unavailable.

tools.name: agentscript_lifecycle
tools.description: Publish inactive Agentforce versions, activate with exact-version evaluation evidence, and manage agent users.

action.description: publish: ship a .agent file as an inactive new agent or version. activate / deactivate: toggle a BotVersion's Status (activation is release-eval gated and idempotent). list_versions: return every BotVersion on the agent. agent_user_status: cheap ready/not_ready/n/a preflight on the agent's user wiring. diagnose_agent_user: full read-only checklist (license, user, system PS, per-apex-class access). provision_agent_user: idempotently bring the org up to spec (creates user, assigns system PS, deploys + assigns custom PS for apex actions). Defaults to dry_run=true; pass dry_run=false to mutate.

agent_file.description: Required for action='publish'. Optional for action='activate' — when provided, runs a divergence check (warns when local .agent is newer than the BotVersion you're activating; flags the 'sf project deploy doesn't propagate config' footgun). Required for agent_user_status / diagnose_agent_user / provision_agent_user.

agent_api_name.description: Required for activate/deactivate/list_versions. Optional for publish (defaults to basename of agent_file without .agent).

release_spec_path.description: Optional for action='activate'. Designated release eval spec path; defaults to tests/agentforce/<AgentApiName>.eval.json when present.

acknowledge_untested_activation.description: For action='activate'. Reserved for upstream compatibility. The standalone runtime rejects true; exact-version release evaluation is required.

version.description: Optional for activate/deactivate. Defaults to the latest BotVersion on the agent.

dry_run.description: For action='provision_agent_user'. Default true (preview the plan, no mutations). Pass false to actually create the user / assign PSs / deploy custom PS.

acknowledge_quality_risk.description: For action='publish'. Approve the newly reported High quality rule IDs (or quality-analysis-failed) for this bundle and invocation. Default false.

username_override.description: Optional for action='provision_agent_user'. Provision a specific username instead of the .agent's default_agent_user. Useful when the bundle was authored against a different name than what the org provides.

guidance: Pass explicit file, org, agent, version, and session identifiers; resume state is scoped to the current tool, workspace, and org.
Publish inactive, evaluate the exact version, then activate it with matching release evidence. Untested activation is unavailable.

tools.name: sf_soql
tools.description: API-native SOQL lifecycle tool: schema describe, relationship discovery, validation, query plan, bounded sample/run/count/queryAll, and artifacts.

object.description: sObject API name for schema actions.

format.description: Export artifact format for query.export. Default csv.

max_rows.description: Maximum rows to fetch. Hard-capped by sf-soql.

limit.description: Alias for max_rows in sample/queryAll workflows.

include_plan.description: Run query plan during validation when useful.

allow_unbounded.description: Allow query.run without LIMIT, still hard-capped.

output_mode.description: Reserved output mode for future richer output.

guidance: Use sf_soql before raw CLI and establish current schema/relationship evidence before relying on custom names.
Prefer validation, count, or sample before broad execution; queryAll/deleted-row scope must be explicit and disclosed.
Use the guidePath returned by tools describe for Tooling API, query-plan, artifact, and export guidance.

tools.name: sf_apex
tools.description: API-native Apex lifecycle tool: authoring plan, diagnostics, trace flags, logs, bounded log watch, Anonymous Apex, and targeted tests.

test_only.description: Restrict apex.search to likely test classes.

file.description: Local file path for diagnose.file or log.analyze.

body.description: Anonymous Apex body or raw Apex log body.

user_id.description: Tooling User Id to trace/read logs for.

include_coverage.description: Collect Apex coverage evidence with test.run/test.result.

include_uncovered_lines.description: Include covered/uncovered line arrays in coverage.summary artifacts.

include_members.description: Include suite membership rows in test.suites.

org_wide.description: Include org-wide Apex coverage in coverage.summary.

threshold_percent.description: Coverage threshold signal only; does not fail runs.

tests.description: Targeted tests as ClassName or ClassName.methodName.

suite_names.description: Existing Apex test suite names to run.

report_formats.description: Optional Apex test report artifact formats.

output_mode.description: Reserved output mode for future richer output.

semantic_checks.description: Enable Jorje semantic checks for diagnose.file. Default true; false checks syntax only. Org schema is not fetched. Native warnings remain warnings.

guidance: Use sf_apex before raw CLI for Apex lifecycle evidence; the calling harness's file tools own source edits and focused tests should reproduce behavior before changes when feasible.
Anonymous Apex is a bounded probe or rollback rehearsal, not a substitute for maintainable targeted tests.
Use the guidePath returned by tools describe for trace, log, test, coverage, and artifact workflows.

tools.name: sf_lwc
tools.description: Local-native LWC lifecycle tool: project scan, component inspection, focused diagnostics, targeted local Jest tests, and artifacts.

workspace.description: Workspace or SFDX project path. Defaults to cwd.

package_dir.description: SFDX package directory to scan, such as force-app.

components.description: Reserved component list for future use.

file.description: Local LWC file path for diagnosis or test planning.

files.description: Local LWC file paths for diagnosis.

test_file.description: Local LWC Jest test file path.

test_name.description: Exact LWC Jest test name to run.

test_pattern.description: Advanced Jest --testNamePattern. Prefer test_name when exact.

limit.description: Maximum items to show inline. Artifacts remain complete.

include_source.description: Include source snippets in component inspection artifacts.

report_formats.description: Guaranteed local test report artifact formats. V1 always writes JSON/stdout/stderr/markdown.

timeout_seconds.description: Bounded local Jest timeout. Default 120 seconds; clamped to 1..300.

output_mode.description: Reserved output mode for future richer output.

guidance: Use sf_lwc for local LWC inspection, diagnostics, and focused Jest evidence before raw npm commands; normal file tools own edits.
sf_lwc never deploys, retrieves, installs dependencies, starts watch mode, or substitutes for Apex/schema/browser evidence.
Use the guidePath returned by tools describe for lifecycle boundaries and cross-tool handoffs.

tools.name: sf_flow
tools.description: Lean Salesforce Flow lifecycle tool: core-five authoring plans, project scan, local diagnostics and Mermaid topology, source-bound safe quick fixes, check-only validation, explicit guarded activation/deactivation, and targeted Flow tests.

workspace.description: SFDX workspace path. Defaults to cwd.

flow_name.description: Exact Flow API name for lifecycle actions.

version.description: Exact existing Flow version to activate.

allow_mutation.description: Required execution-intent flag for Flow activation/deactivation; per-call effect authorization remains separate.

flow_type.description: Explicit core Flow family when intent alone is ambiguous.

record_event.description: Record operation that starts a record-triggered Flow.

flow_names.description: Flow API names containing Flow tests.

run_id.description: Flow test run ID for test.result.

fix_id.description: Source-bound quick-fix ID returned by diagnose.file.

source_version.description: Exact source version returned by diagnose.file.

wait_seconds.description: Bounded Flow test wait. Default 60 seconds.

report_formats.description: Optional Flow test report artifact formats.

quality_profile.description: Quality rule profile for diagnose.file or quality.rules.

limit.description: Maximum inline items. Artifacts remain complete.

guidance: Use sf_flow before generic XML reasoning for Flow metadata; the calling harness's file tools own source edits.
Pass target_org to sf_flow author.plan when custom fields, actions, or subflow contracts must be grounded before authoring; omitted targets keep planning local.
Use sf_flow diagnose.file before validate.check; check-only validation never deploys or activates a Flow.
Use sf_flow fix.apply only with a current fix_id and source_version returned by diagnose.file; stale or unsupported fixes are refused.
Use sf_flow lifecycle.status for canonical REST lifecycle evidence; do not delegate FlowDefinitionView lifecycle verification to generic SOQL guessing.

Use sf_flow deploy.activate for one exact local Flow file, sf_flow lifecycle.activate for one exact existing version, and sf_flow lifecycle.deactivate for deterministic deactivation. Mutations require explicit target_org and allow_mutation=true, remain subject to per-call effect authorization, and refuse production or unknown orgs.
Do not invent `sf flow activate` or manually build temporary activation projects; SF CLI has no such Flow activation command.
Use sf_flow targeted Flow tests only after an eligible Flow test exists in the org.
Use the guidePath returned by tools describe for core Flow families, lifecycle ordering, and proof boundaries.
